intros Ω m X μ
let cgf := ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ
let integrableExpSet := ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ
let interiorIntegrableExpSet := interior integrableExpSet

let open MeasureTheory in
let open ProbabilityTheory in

have h_integrable_exp_set : integrableExpSet = {λ : ℝ | ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ENNReal.ofReal (exp (λ * X ω)) ∂μ < ∞} :=
  by rw [integrableExpSet]

let h_interior := interiorIntegrableExpSet

let h_open := isOpen_integrableExpSet X μ

let h_analytic_on :=
  by {
    apply analyticOn_cgf,
    exact h_open,
  }

exact h_analytic_on
